title: Venezuelan-Style Smoked Fish Skewers
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines the rich flavors of Venezuelan cuisine with the tender texture of smoked fish.

ingredients.name: Venezuelan-style seasoning blend (annatto, cumin, coriander, garlic)

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Venezuelan-style seasoning blend, smoked paprika, and lime juice.
Add the fish fillets to the bowl and coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the marinated fish onto skewers.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the fish skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
